acceptance: Grants change only through compare-and-swap; revocation wins over refresh, pause, resume and expiry; revoked grants never revive; refresh is single-flight and cannot resurrect revoked credentials; failed deletion never leaves a credential authorized.

positive.fixture: store contract; refresh racing revoke discards its tokens; two concurrent refreshes spend a rotating token once; deterministic barriers

negative.fixture: stale writer cannot revive or widen; revoke between check and commit wins; stale resume against a newer pause; deletion failures; secret write failures at each step

security_and_source_permissions: Revocation is effective before cleanup; a rotated credential that cannot be stored ends the grant.
performance_memory_storage: Lock striping bounds locks; refresh holds no lock during network I/O.
known_limitations: In-process atomicity only; a shared store must implement Swap atomically
